SELECT SUM(s.NumTstTakr) AS TotalSATTestTakers
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.CDSCode = s.cds
WHERE f.`FRPM Count (K-12)` IN (
    SELECT MAX(`FRPM Count (K-12)`)
    FROM frpm
);
